cohort: The study included 23,352 infants at least 35 weeks' gestation admitted to a university-affiliated newborn nursery.
finding: The study established hour-specific axillary temperature percentiles for late preterm and term infants, finding the median temperature ranged from 36.9°C at birth to 37.0°C at 48 hours, with the widest temperature range at birth which narrowed thereafter.
mod_finding: Infants delivered via cesarean section had lower temperatures at birth compared to infants born vaginally.
